title: Can’t even use basic functionality without paying
body: Asking for premium that costs ₹500 just to do the most basic task that is click to mark a date. This is literally the simplest an app can get. Uninstalled this and created my own in 10 mins with Claude.
author: Ron|K

title: Great app
body:
Its a great app , do not require unnecessary login. 
I like these things
1. We can change the Icons.
2. We can add Short or Long notes. 
3. No need to signup or provide personal info to just mark something on calendar. 
Loved the developers effort and design 👍

title: App forcing to buy premium after one week free use
